names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9570, «Евстафий (Малаховский), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname at all — «Сщмч. Евстафия пресвитера (1918).» — so the surname is read off the name link, where the calendar prints it, and it is part of the name and stays. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'евстафии малаховскии' has no other holder in the corpus.

death.note: The year the day line prints for him: «Сщмч. Евстафия пресвитера (1918).» No year of birth appears on either of the two pages that name him, and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Евстафия пресвитера (1918).»

attestations.note: The day’s seventh entry. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line carries a link to his name and none to a reading. What the name page, 9570, gives that the line does not is the surname «Малаховский» and the grade «иерей», priest, written out beside «сщмч.». It heads «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 22 апреля»; 26 января is the general commemoration of the new martyrs and confessors, which is how `new-martyr` is read into `types`, and that day page was NOT READ. The name page also carries a link under «Статья на Православие.Ru» to an article by Марина Бирюкова, «Три подвига отца Евстафия», with one teaser sentence; it is a magazine article on the same site and not the calendar’s own life, and IT WAS NOT READ — named here because a reader who opens the cited page will see it and because it is the one place a second reading of this man is to be had. NO FOLDER WAS FOUND FOR HIM: `grep -ril 'Малаховск'` over `saints/` returns nothing, and of the corpus’s thirteen Eustathius folders the only other one of this shape, `eustathius-sokolsky`, is a different surname. The day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
